description: This Python source file defines classes and functions for tracking and debugging memory allocations and deallocations during the runtime of the PyTorch inductor component. It includes a class BufferMemoryTracker for managing tensor lifecycle tracking, utility functions for memory checking, and integration with PyTorch's custom operator library.

classes.name: BufferMemoryTracker
classes.description: Tracks inductor runtime allocations and deallocations to compare against expected behavior.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the BufferMemoryTracker with internal data structures and configuration.

methods.name: None set_tensor(self, name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Associates a tensor with a name and tracks its lifecycle, setting up a finalizer for deallocation.

methods.name: None advance_step(self)
methods.description: Clears tracking info for the next step.

methods.name: None log_or_raise(self, msg: str)
methods.description: Logs an info message or raises an error based on configuration.

methods.name: None check_step_delta( self, expected_allocated: list[str], expected_freed: list[str], is_final_step: bool, )
methods.description: Checks for discrepancies in tensor allocations/deallocations since the last step.

methods.name: BufferMemoryTracker get_mem_tracker()
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of BufferMemoryTracker, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: None track_tensor(tensor: torch.Tensor, name: str)
methods.description: Tracks a tensor with a given name using the memory tracker.

methods.name: torch.Tensor tracked_empty_strided( size: list[int], stride: list[int], *, dtype: torch.dtype, device: torch.device, name: str, )
methods.description: Creates an empty strided tensor and tracks its memory.

methods.name: None check_memory_step( allocated: list[str], freed: list[str], is_final_step: bool = False )
methods.description: Utility function to check memory state at a specific step, used externally.

methods.name: None register_check_mem_op()
methods.description: Registers a custom operator for checking memory step in torch library.
